  1. Must see · Changi

    Jewel Changi Airport & HSBC Rain Vortex

    Glass-domed nature-and-retail complex housing the world's tallest indoor waterfall (40 m) and Shiseido Forest Valley.

    Look for Landmark

    78 Airport Boulevard, Changi Airport

    Recommended by Changi Airport (official), Wikipedia (English)

  2. Worth the detour · Changi

    Changi Chapel & Museum

    NHB museum commemorating WWII POWs interned at Changi, with a replica of the Changi Chapel.

    Look for Museum

    1000 Upper Changi Road North, Changi

    Recommended by National Heritage Board, Wikipedia (English)
